body.p: To push your local repository changes to the remote repository, use the Push action from the view's toolbar, the Ellipsis menu, or the Git main menu.

To bring the changes from the remote repository into your local repository, use one of the pull actions from the Pull drop-down menu located on the toolbar (), the Ellipsis menu, or the Git main menu.
In the Pull drop-down menu, you can choose between Pull (merge) and Pull (rebase). The invoked action is promoted as the current action of the toolbar button.

In the Ellipsis menu and the Git main menu, there is also a Pull... action that allows you to pull changes from a remote branch other than the one being tracked. This action displays a dialog box where you can choose the remote branch and the pull strategy (merge or rebase).
body.note: When pushing a local branch that does not have a corresponding remote branch, a remote branch will automatically be created with the same name as the local branch.
